_about: Hand-kept notes for the Cosmos tab: who owns each facet, its stage, the next step, and the work log. Numbers are not kept here; scripts/tool-surface.mjs recomputes them from the cosmos registry and sweep. Seeded 2026-10-11 from the Cosmos Cube Board artifact.

reality.name: Reality
reality.next: The 6.5 / 7.0 / 7.5 rungs are the 7th-gen agent’s. Structure here stays shared.

space.name: Space
space.next: Top-down camera is third in the build order (M). First person is now partial: it already plays.

power.name: Power
power.next: Dodge, tackle, loadout cycling and boost inertia are engine verbs now (MX2b). Turn-based combat remains the one absent value.

soul.name: Soul
soul.next: Party play in a level (M) ranks low; it waits.

time.name: Time
time.next: Its own branch: you and another agent, seeded by the tutorial step director.

log.text: Battle city, phases 1 to 7 (1025-battle-city): one contest kernel (match, meet, turns) with the ball card, the hit and the minds; the meet, the court, the course and the pitch on the World page; the quick goals meet and contest; a sport written out from a distilled rulebook. The four sport values read built; the hero body on the pitch and the engines’ kernels are the gaps left.

Battle city priced (1025-battle-city): sports as a contest over the movement stack. Four probes (an athletics meet, a net game, a turn sport, a team goal game) and the values they wait on: the meet and contest mechanics, a court level form, a team, a positional motivation, one package. The ball already exists (physics-sim's sphere with spin and restitution, flight.js's real air); the contest kernel does not.

MX11 (a795157c): animals live in packs and herds. Wolves fan out and ring their prey, two biting at a time; herds graze together and scatter as one. Plus 3aeb28bd: rules now read the world clock (memory, regrowth and shared sight were reading 0).

MX10 (7cc8c56e): groups. N minds share a target, sight and spacing; traversal patterns (column, line, wedge, fan-out, encircle, pincer, close, scatter) chain into plans; attack tokens let K press in at once.
Operator played the Mind demo: 'it works … every creature reacted differently.' MX9 (f8163b2d): predators hunt with a natural bite that lunges; prey flee any hunter.
MX8 landed (2a30c94c): idle minds wander, graze food, escort a ward, and warn intruders before attacking. Every Mind motivation now resolves built. Makeable 46 → 61, blocked 269 → 215 of 500.
MX7 landed (59d0ee7c): minds can be limited to what they see (range, facing cone, line of sight), and remember where they last saw you: they go there, search, then give up.

MX5 landed (b560dcbe): minds find their way round walls. A* over a walk grid baked from the colliders; a hunter stuck behind a wall now walks out and round. Blocked games 297 → 269 of 500. Next context: competition and racing (plan drafted).

MX6 landed (3434b88e): bosses cross health phases (bolder under 2/3, relentless and closing to the blade under 1/3, with a short invincible beat) and adapt by benching the fighting mode that lost the trade. Minibosses adapt when asked.

MX4 landed (99af1dc6): the arena's commander is an engine module. A body marked rule.commanded is driven at strategy rate by the built-in commander, a page hook or an HTTP endpoint. The arena's 29 behaviour tests moved beside the engine. Kite and the built-in commander are built; makeable 40 → 45 of 500. The mobile-suit branch leaves the merge plan.

MX3 landed (9c150c0c): a guard engages only near its post and walks back to it; prey flees inside its fear radius. Animals' minds run on the engine. The top-down adventure is now blocked only by its camera.
MX2b landed (a2671ff1): the suit maneuvers became engine verbs. The mobile-suit pack tracks nothing; the arena is fully absorbed and its traces are byte-identical.
MX2 landed (76bd23d0): ms-ai.js retired. Per-character tuning over the class tier; passive and defensive temperaments. Makeable games 11 → 40 of 500; the arena brawler is fully makeable.

The arena's ai rule moved into the engine as the mind. All four controllable traces byte-identical, the three arena bouts included; 13 page pins re-pinned after proving only the embedded engine source changed.
MX1 landed (a380c626): the mind matrix, a generated table for every named mind and species, and the Mind facet on the new axes. A miniboss rotates; a boss also shifts at health phases and adapts.
Moved to my own worktree and branch, 1010-mind-matrix, from 9c2c1e50; the other session keeps 1010-cosmos-sweep.
Paused: another session is editing the 1010-cosmos-sweep worktree (Time facet, fixtures, and core sweep files). MX1 parked outside it; nothing of theirs touched.
MX1: the arena's easy, medium and max tiers equal novice×wary, regular×bold and ace×opportunist exactly. Deer flee from their prey tag; wolves cannot hunt yet (no animal holds an attack verb).
Skill is a base for a class of minds, tuned per character. Duelling is a rank: minibosses and bosses hold a repertoire and switch through it.

Mind becomes a matrix like fauna behavior: motivation × actions × capability × aggressiveness. The arena is absorbed as a preset and then retired. Fauna tags (predator, prey) give every species a mind for free.
Committed S1–S2 (9c2c1e50). From here each step commits when its machine gates pass; nothing is pushed.
S1–S2: every gap carries an effort and a work package; the sweep ranks packages by lifts per unit of work. The general mind leads.
First person already plays (a heroless walker); the registry said absent. Corrected to partial.
Sized the gaps with three read-only sweeps: Mind's lift is moderate extraction under existing traces; pathfinding needs the walk grid shipped to the page; turn-based combat is the largest build.
Split the work: a separate agent takes 7th-gen scaling (Reality's rungs); Claude takes the cosmos structure and the gaps in Space, Power, Soul and Mind.
This board went live.
Rebased onto 1d797412 (the 3.1.0 fold). test:critical fully green.
Sweep draw density set to 0.2 and ranking by lifts, so the map says something.
P3–P4: fixtures, the seeded sweep, the unlock ranking and the CLI.
Mind exists only inside the mobile-suit arena: recorded as local, a mine to lift.
Time goes to its own branch, built by you with another agent; time.js ships as an honest stub.
P0–P2: the facet schema, a generated capability registry, depth and the dry run (ea1f464c).
Named the cosmos cube and its six facets; the Reality facet is the geocube.
